rationale: The assistant first suggested a control board or relay fault, which was unsupported and speculative. It then correctly identified the normal anti-crease phase once the customer said they didn't know what it meant. No part was recommended and no engineer was called for. Weaknesses: it never pointed the customer to the manual to switch anti-crease off or to unload promptly, and the 'prop the door ajar' tip is a bit shaky. It also gave a firm conclusion without having asked about the programme.
